Title: Azure Container Registry—Diagnostic logs are now in preview

Body.Content:
Diagnostic logs for Azure Container Registry are now in preview.

Logs are available for:

  • Authentication and repository-level events for registry authentication events and status.
  • Operations such as push and pull for images and other artifacts in registry repositories.
  • Container registry metrics such as aggregated push and pull counts.

Learn more
